name: Windham Parks & Recreation Summer Day Camp
description_short: A 7-week town-run summer day camp for grades 1-8, 7:30am-5:30pm, based at Windham High School and Windham Middle School. Campers are split into Discover Camp (grades 1-3), Ranger Camp (grades 4-5) and Adventure Camp (grades 6-8), with field trips, special events, arts and crafts, sports and games. Adventure Camp ends with an overnight whitewater rafting trip.

warnings: This page is the department's general overview of youth and family programs, not a dedicated camp page. Its details are an undated 'sample' of offerings, and current info is on rec.us/windham and the separate 'Summer Day Camp' page.
The page doesn't name a season year, so season_year is left blank. Registration is described as opening 'the last Monday in March and runs through late May' each year.
The same page lists other summer programs (Tennis Camp in July, Paddling Camp in August, Summer Track & Field, Summer Enrichment). These are separate programs and are not part of this listing.
The page shows two phone numbers: 207-892-1905 for Parks & Rec and 207-892-1907 for the Town office. The Parks & Rec number was recorded.

swim_waterfront_notes: Field trips include lakes and the ocean, and staff go into the water with campers. Grades 1-3 may go waist deep in lakes and knee deep in the ocean; grades 4-5 chest deep in lakes and waist deep in the ocean; neither group ever goes over their heads. Grades 6-8 must tread water for 2 minutes to go over their heads in lakes, in groups of 3 with an adult. Tell the camp director if your child can't swim.
